chunks: He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad narrated to me, from Ali ibn Mahrwayh al-Qazwini, from Dawud ibn Sulayman al-Ghazi, from al-Ridha Ali ibn Musa, from his father Musa ibn Ja'far, from his father Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father Muhammad ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father al-Husayn ibn Ali, from his father Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them all, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, said:
An angel came to me and said: "O Muhammad, your Lord sends you greetings of peace and says: If you wish, I will turn the plain of Makkah into gold for you."
He (the Prophet) said: So I raised my head toward the heavens and said: "O my Lord, let me eat to my fill one day so that I praise You, and let me go hungry another day so that I ask of You."

key_terms.أجوع: To go hungry, to experience hunger
key_terms.أحمدك: I praise You, I thank You (from hamd, praise/gratitude)
key_terms.أسألك: I ask of You, I beseech You (supplication to God)
key_terms.أشبع: To eat to one's fill, to be satiated
key_terms.بطحاء مكة: The wide valley/plain of Makkah, a spacious area in the city

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say when an angel offered to turn Makkah into gold?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) was offered by God through an angel to have the entire plain of Makkah turned into gold, yet he chose a life alternating between satiety and hunger. This reflects the prophetic ideal of contentment (zuhd), showing that true spiritual wealth lies in gratitude during ease and supplication during hardship, rather than in material abundance. The narration was delivered through the famous golden chain (silsilat al-dhahab) through all the Imams back to the Prophet.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad reported to me from ‘Ali ibn Mahrwayh al-Qazwini, who reported from Dawood ibn Sulaiman al-Ghazi, who reported from al-Ridha, ‘Ali ibn Musa, from his father, Musa ibn Ja’far, from his father Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from his father Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, from his father ‘Ali ibn Husayn, from his father al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali, from his father ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them all, that: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:
An angel appeared to me and said: "O Muhammad! Your Sustainer sends you peaceful greetings and says: if you so desire, We can turn the entire plain of Makkah into gold."

He said (i.e. the Prophet): I raised my head towards the heavens and said: "O, my Sustainer! (let it be that) one day, I eat to my fill, so that I praise You with gratitude and one day, I remain hungry so that I (experience the pleasure to) seek from You."
